player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma a ɛtrɛw {num_rounds} round.

Agyinamoa:
- Ansana woahyɛ biribiara no, wo wɔ {total_conversation_rounds} turns sɛ wo bɛtumi akasa pɛpɛɛpɛ.
- Akyiri yi, Player baanu no nyinaa bɛhyɛ sɛ wɔ bɛyɛ biako anaa wɔ bɛgyae.

Payoff Matrix (ɛyɛ koko da round):
- Player baanu no nyinaa yɛ biako ➜ obiara {cooperate_reward}
- Player baanu no nyinaa gyae ➜ obiara {mutual_defect_reward}
- Obi gyae, obi yɛ biako ➜ Gyani no {defect_reward}, Obi yɛ biako no {sucker_reward}

Sɛnea wo bɛyɛ:
- Sɛ wɔre kasamu: to nkyerɛwee biara wo pɛ.
- Sɛ wɔre yɛ biribi: fa '[Cooperate]' anaa '[Defect]' ka ho (ɛnsɛ sɛ wo hwɛ kɛseɛ). Wo betumi aka nkyerɛwee bi ka ho ansana anaa akyiri.
